name: get_stack_trace
description: Get stack trace. The response includes stopReason — why the session is paused. For an implicit frameless stopped thread, a sibling with policy-recognized user frames is preferred and adopted, with the switch disclosed in note. Internal/runtime frames are filtered by default; when any are hidden the response carries hiddenFrames and a note. When the frame the program is paused in is itself internal, pausedFrame names it (kept: whether it was retained as stackFrames[0]) and the note says so

includeInternals.description: Include internal/framework frames (e.g., Node.js internals, node_modules dependencies, async separators). Default: false for cleaner output.

threadId.description: Inspect this exact thread (ids from list_threads). Explicit selection is authoritative and is never silently switched
